Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview.
Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification.

Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable).
Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification.
Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview.
Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities.
Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Acharya N.G. Ranga Agricultural University (ANGRAU).

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in this ANGRAU recruitment?
faq.answer: The available posts are Teaching Associate and Teaching Assistant.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are there in ANGRAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 11 vacancies for Teaching Associate/Teaching Assistant posts.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for these posts?
faq.answer: The application mode is a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q5. What is the walk-in interview date for ANGRAU Teaching Associate/Assistant posts?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 31 August 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the maximum age limit for a Teaching Associate?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for a Teaching Associate is 45 years.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for a Ph.D. holder Teaching Associate?
faq.answer: Ph.D. holders appointed as Teaching Associate will receive Rs. 67,000/- per month plus applicable HRA*.

faq.question: Q8. What are the essential qualifications for a Teaching Assistant?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a B.Sc (Ag)/B.Tech (Ag.Engg) degree of four years from ICAR accredited Universities/Colleges only.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for ANGRAU Teaching Associate/Assistant?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-in-interview followed by a Medical examination.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the Office of the Associate Director of Research, Regional Agricultural Research Station, Lam, Guntur-522034.
